To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of content-based search can be effective in downloading/ recording digital video.
the content-based approach can be used to record digital video in a home environment, with some limitations.

(1) content-based search can be used to trigger downloading digital video into a client station, and (2) a content-based approach can be used to download/record video into home VCRs with the option of preloading the pattern to be searched.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design and evaluation of a new approach to downloading video content from networks to home VCRs and other client stations, and with the development of a new concept of go-ahead-download for this approach.
the development of a new paradigm of digital video downloading and its implementation in a home VCR environment.
the development of a new method for downloading/record digital video into a client station.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
content-based search is a promising approach for downloading digital video into client stations.
content-based searching is a feasible approach for downloading digital video, but its performance is highly dependent upon the content of the video and the downloading capacity of the device.
content-based search is a viable method for downloading digital video, and that a number of content search methods can be effectively used.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a content-based search can be used as a complement of the conventional time-based search in downloading digital video.
the content-based method is a promising technique for recording digital video.
content-based search can be used to download digital video to client stations and VCRs, but only when the system capacity of the device is not an issue.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of content-based search and go-ahead-downloading can be used to provide the same or even better service to users as time-based downloading.
content-based downloading of digital video is feasible and can be a viable alternative to time-based recording.
the content-based approach is a viable alternative to the time-based approach for downloading digital video.
